thread:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — CT Therapeutics usage has dropped ~72% w/w for generation and ~65% for embeddings. Renewal is ~30 days out. Hearing they started a small pilot with CompetitorX. Need to triage and recommend retention steps. Any context on stakeholder changes or blockers?
tyler_ae: saw lower activity in the dashboard yesterday, thanks for flagging. I had a call a week ago with Ben, they mentioned new ML partner evaluation but no formal decision yet.
ben_ct: hey team — yes we spun up a parallel eval with CompetitorX for a specific summarization flow. Still early but they're faster on short examples. Not happy with docs throughput right now.
maria_cs: thanks Ben. Helpful to know it's narrow to summarization. Do you have any logs/latency numbers? rough traffic patterns?
ben_ct: latency there is about +40% for long docs, so our users retry less. We also removed one integration in favor of a vendor PoC.
olivia_pm: pinging from product — do we know if they switched model config or changed batch sizes? any recent rollout?
eng-bot: analysis summary: last 14 days vs prior 14 days — gen tokens: -72%, embedding calls: -65%, avg gen latency: +32% for sequences >1k tokens, 95th p90 token latency +45%. Top routes impacted: /summarize, /bulk-embeddings.
maria_cs: ok so looks like latency on long sequences drove a targeted pilot. Action items: 1) schedule short call with Ben + engineering to demo our long-doc improvements and kernel/quantization plan (owner: tyler_ae) 2) offer 30-day trial extension and a dedicated performance tune (owner: maria_cs) 3) prepare comparison doc vs CompetitorX focusing on long-doc throughput + cost (owner: olivia_pm).
clara_csm_mgr: +1 to the action items. classify as at-risk but recoverable. Recommend escalation to AM for commercial concession only if demo doesn't land. Please add urgency: renewal in 30 days.
tyler_ae: I can run a focused perf session tomorrow 10am PT with Ben — will include a quick synthetic long-doc run and show `kv-cache`/batching impact. Ben — does that time work?
ben_ct: tomorrow 10am PT works. Would like devs on the call to look at logs.
maria_cs: I'll prep a short triage deck and include before/after perf numbers and a one-pager on our long-doc tuning playbook. Also will surface telemetry queries so Ben's team can validate.
olivia_pm: I'll draft the competitor comparison (2 slides) with cost per 1M tokens and expected p95 for >1k sequences.
clara_csm_mgr: also add an enablement offer: 1-hour onsite/remote performance workshop + prioritized support channel for the next 30 days. Mention SLA on performance regressions.
maria_cs: noted. I'm going to add a link to the usage dashboard in the invite and tag the routes impacted.
tyler_ae: tagging in agenda: 1) root-cause quick check 2) live perf run 3) proposed config + short-term mitigation 4) next steps/commercial note.
ben_ct: thanks everyone. appreciate the quick response. If the perf fix reduces retries we'll likely pull back from the pilot.
maria_cs: assigning follow-ups: tyler_ae (demo + perf), olivia_pm (comp doc), me (trial extension offer + deck). I'll update this thread after the call with outcome. :eyes: :thumbsup:
clara_csm_mgr: please mark renewal playbook entry and set a watch flag in Gainsight. If demo doesn't move the needle, prepare a commercial concession play but keep it limited. :warning:
maria_cs: will do. Thanks team — prepping materials now.
